# DLC emulators (upstream Kraken Mount v0.3.0)

Bundled files are unmodified released dlc_emu 0.3 binaries by drakmor, copied by Git SHA from quer3q/kraken-mount v0.3.0. Corresponding source: https://github.com/drakmor/dlc_emu/tree/0.3 (GPL-3.0). They are written into a game's fakelib only when needed. SHA-256 checks apply during the unified build.
